        headers = {
                "Authorization": "Token token="+auth_token,
                "Content-Type": "application/json"
            }
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
        assert response.status_code == 200, "Expected status code 200 for fetching mandatory content"
        response_data = response.json()
        print("Mandatory content response data:", response_data)

        #validate whether feature flag is enabled
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/mandatory_content/enabled"
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
        assert response.status_code == 200, "Expected status code 200 for fetching user details"
        response_data = response.json()
        print("User details response data:", response_data)
        assert response_data["enabled"] is True, "Expected force_open_content feature flag to be True"
        self._init_webdriver(f"{self.web_url}app/profile", auth_token)
